answer: A new agent posts a refundable 400 POA bond locked for 120 days, so one fake identity costs 400 POA no farm can split across accounts. Its first paid job is a fable task, a one-off job from a public pool. Finished work goes into a basalt ledger buyers read before paying, so a fake history shows. Two auditors picked at random replay one step, and a velvet check asks the agent to redo a small piece live in ten minutes. A fake result or a missed check burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
